tagline: We unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together for health impact, shareholder returns and thriving people
hero_kpi_rationale: R&D is the primary driver of value creation in the biopharma sector. GSK dedicates 18% of its revenue (£6.4 billion) to it, with strong integration of advanced technologies such as AI at each stage of the discovery and development process.

kpis.name: R&D Investments
kpis.explanation: Total amount of research and development spending in 2024.
kpis.description: GSK maintains a high level of R&D investment, central to its innovation strategy in specialized therapeutics. Represents 18% of revenue.
kpis.signal: £6.4 billion invested in R&D in 2024, including use of AI and technology platforms

kpis.name: Global Workforce
kpis.description: Global workforce distributed across 75 countries, key to drug discovery, development and distribution.
kpis.signal: 68,600 expert collaborators in science, technology and manufacturing

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Consolidated gross margin on an upward trajectory, reflecting improved manufacturing efficiency and product mix.
kpis.signal: High gross margin, typical of innovative biopharma companies

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin expansion driven by rigorous cost management and sales growth.
kpis.signal: Improvement in operating profitability despite R&D investment

kpis.name: Patients Reached (cumulative 2021-2024)
kpis.explanation: Estimated number of patients touched by GSK products between 2021 and 2024, on track toward the 2.5 billion target by end of decade.
kpis.description: Key health impact indicator, reflecting the global reach of GSK vaccines and medicines. On track to reach 2.5 billion people by end of decade.
kpis.signal: At least 2 billion patients reached since 2021

kpis.name: Corporate Taxes Paid
kpis.explanation: Amount of corporate income tax paid by GSK worldwide.
kpis.description: Significant tax contribution in the United Kingdom and internationally, supporting the economy.
kpis.signal: £1.3 billion in taxes paid, in addition to other taxes

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €61.12 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €17.72 billion in the latest year

risks.title: Intense competition in specialized medicines
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned indirectly in the analysis of the specialized medicines portfolio, with language emphasizing growing competitive pressure in oncology and immunology. The trend is upward due to expansion of competitive pipeline. The 'Competition' category is central for GSK.

risks.title: Dependence on critical suppliers
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions 18,000 suppliers working directly with GSK, highlighting a complex and potentially vulnerable supply chain. Language implies high operational risk in case of disruption. Central position in the report.

risks.title: Strict regulation of vaccines and medicines
risks.score_rationale: The risk is strongly highlighted, notably with regulatory challenges in the United States and China for Arexvy and Shingrix. Intensive language and prominent position in the report. Critical category for the pharmaceutical sector.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of R&D data
risks.score_rationale: Growing reliance on AI and data in R&D is emphasized, implying increased exposure to cyber threats. Language is cautious but concerned. Emerging but strategic category.

risks.title: Intellectual property protection
risks.score_rationale: IP is fundamental to protecting innovations such as Blenrep or depemokimab. Language is implicit but the issue is crucial. Central position in innovation strategy. Strategic category.

risks.title: Dependence on R&D pipeline success
risks.score_rationale: The pipeline is described as the engine of future growth, with 71 assets in development. Highly positive language but implicit on failure risk. Central category, upward trend.

risks.title: Product safety litigation
risks.score_rationale: The Zantac litigation settlement for £1.8 billion is explicitly mentioned. Strong language and major event in results. Category on sharp upward trajectory.

ai_positioning.summary: GSK actively integrates AI and data technologies into its R&D process to accelerate drug discovery and improve efficacy prediction.
evidence: Use of AI and data technologies at each stage of the R&D process
Objective to make R&D faster, more efficient and more predictive
Collaborations with technology players and biotechs
